Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting liability for boards of directors or officers of nonprofit corporations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to liability of boards of directors or officers ofnonprofit corporations; and amending RCW 4.24.264.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 4.24.264 and 1987 c 212 s 1101 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in subsection (((2))) (3) of this section,a member of the board of directors or an officer of any nonprofitcorporation is not individually liable for any discretionary decisionor failure to make a discretionary decision within his or her officialcapacity as director or officer unless the decision or failure todecide constitutes gross negligence. (2) A member of the board of directors or an officer of a nonprofitcorporation is not individually liable for the nonprofit's failure tocomply with provisions of the Washington administrative code, unlesssuch failure to comply constitutes gross negligence. (3) Nothing in this section shall limit or modify in any manner theduties or liabilities of a director or officer of a corporation to the p. 1 SB 6313corporation or the corporation's members.
